body:
I ran your MRP locally. It seems that you are not using the color from the Particles shader in your rendering shader. 

Note especially the [docs](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/classes/class_particleprocessmaterial.html#class-particleprocessmaterial-property-color) for these properties which all have a variation of the following note:

> Note: [color](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/classes/class_particleprocessmaterial.html#class-particleprocessmaterial-property-color) multiplies the particle mesh's vertex colors. To have a visible effect on a [BaseMaterial3D](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/classes/class_basematerial3d.html#class-basematerial3d), [BaseMaterial3D.vertex_color_use_as_albedo](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/classes/class_basematerial3d.html#class-basematerial3d-property-vertex-color-use-as-albedo) must be true. For a [ShaderMaterial](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/classes/class_shadermaterial.html#class-shadermaterial), ALBEDO *= COLOR.rgb; must be inserted in the shader's fragment() function. Otherwise, [color](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/classes/class_particleprocessmaterial.html#class-particleprocessmaterial-property-color) will have no visible effect.

Enabling `[vertex_color_use_as_albedo](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/classes/class_basematerial3d.html#class-basematerial3d-property-vertex-color-use-as-albedo)` is enough to fix the problem in your case!

As for the ribbon issue. The issue you linked was closed as a duplicate of another issue which was subsequently fixed! I suspect that you are bumping up against a different issue. In which case it would be great if you could open a bug report with an MRP so we can investigate that issue further. 

@AThousandShips This note is something good to add to your tracker of things for the bugsquad to be aware of that new users miss a lot. We have tried repeating it in the documentation everywhere we can, but it still catches people unaware.
